stemMarkdown: A pipe can fill a cistern in 8 hours, while a waste pipe at the bottom can empty the full cistern in 15 hours. If both are opened together, how many hours will the cistern take to fill? (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: The filling pipe adds $\dfrac{1}{8}$ per hour and the waste pipe removes $\dfrac{1}{15}$ per hour, so the net rate is $\dfrac{1}{8} - \dfrac{1}{15} = 0.058333$ per hour. The cistern fills in $17.1429$ hours.
altSolutionMarkdown: An emptying pipe is simply a negative rate — the arithmetic is otherwise identical.
